responsibility: Implements the main vectorizer pattern-recognition framework for scalar GIMPLE statements. It scans vectorization candidates in loops and basic blocks, recognizes idioms that should be replaced by more directly vectorizable pattern statements, creates and records those synthetic pattern stmts and any supporting def sequences in stmt_vec_info metadata, derives precisions and range-based information used by recognizers, and marks original statements so later analysis and transformation vectorize the pattern result instead of the scalar expansion.
